Expand description

An error that occurred during validation/

Variants§

§

TooLongString

There was a string that was longer than the maximum allowed length (32767).

Can for example occur if you set a title or an author that is longer than the given length.

§

TooLongName

There was a name that was longer than the maximum allowed length (127).

Can for example occur if the font name is too long.

§

TooLongArray

There was an array that was longer than the maximum allowed length (8191). Can only occur for PDF 1.4.

Can for example occur if a text too long was written.

§

TooLongDictionary

There was a dictionary with more entries than the maximum allowed (4095). Can only occur for PDF 1.4.

Can for example occur if too many annotations are added to a page.

§

TooLargeFloat

There was a float that is higher than the maximum allowed (32767). Can only occur for PDF 1.4.

§

TooManyIndirectObjects

The PDF exceeds the upper limit for indirect objects (8388607).

Occurs if the PDF is simply too long.

§

TooHighQNestingLevel

The PDF contains a content stream that exceeds maximum allowed q/Q nesting level (28).

Can only occur if the user stacks many clip paths.

§

ContainsPostScript(Option<Location>)

The PDF contains PostScript code, which is forbidden by some export formats.

Occurs if a gradient with spread method Repeat/Reflect or a sweep gradient was used.

§

MissingCMYKProfile

No CMYK ICC profile was provided, even though one is necessary.

Occurs if the export format requires a device-independent color representation, and a CMYK color was used in the document.

§

InconsistentSeparationFallback(SeparationColorant)

The same Separation colorant was used with multiple different fallback colors.

Occurs if the user specified multiple Separation color spaces with the same colorant but a different fallback color, or a DeviceN spot colorant whose CMYK alternate differs from the fallback used elsewhere for that name.

§

ContainsNotDefGlyph(Font, Option<Location>, String)

The .notdef glyph was used, which is forbidden by some export formats.

Can occur if a glyph could not be found in the font for a corresponding codepoint in the input text, or if it was explicitly mapped that way.

The third argument contains the text range of the glyph.

§

NoCodepointMapping(Font, GlyphId, Option<Location>)

A glyph was mapped to no codepoint at all, which is forbidden by some standards.

§

InvalidCodepointMapping(Font, GlyphId, char, Option<Location>)

A glyph was mapped either to the codepoint 0x0, 0xFEFF or 0xFFFE, which is forbidden by some standards.

Can occur if those codepoints appeared in the input text, or were explicitly mapped to that glyph.

§

UnicodePrivateArea(Font, GlyphId, char, Option<Location>)

A glyph was mapped to a codepoint in the Unicode private use area, which is forbidden by some standards, like for example PDF/A-2a.

§

RestrictedLicense(Font)

A font has a license that requires explicit permission of the legal owner for embedding but the standard requires font programs to be legally embeddable for universal rendering.

§

NoDocumentLanguage

No document language was set via the metadata, even though it is required by the standard.

§

NoDocumentTitle

No title was provided for the document, even though it is required by the standard.

§

MissingAltText(Option<Location>)

A figure or formula is missing an alt text.

§

MissingHeadingTitle

A heading is missing a title.

§

MissingDocumentOutline

The document does not contain an outline.

§

MissingAnnotationAltText(Option<Location>)

An annotation is missing an alt text.

§

MissingDocumentDate

The date of the document is missing.

§

Transparency(Option<Location>)

The PDF contains transparency, which is forbidden by some standards (e.g. PDF/A-1).

§

ImageInterpolation(Option<Location>)

The PDF contains an image with interpolate set to true.

§

OverprintModeIccCmyk(Option<Location>)

Overprint mode 1 (/OPM 1) was combined with fill or stroke overprint while CMYK colors are ICCBased.

PDF/A-2 and later forbid overprint mode 1 when an ICCBased CMYK color space is used for a side that overprints. Validated export always writes CMYK as ICCBased, so any Overprint with nonzero and fill or stroke set triggers it; use nonzero: false there.

§

PdfxVersionWithoutExtensionSchema

SerializeSettings::pdfx_version is set. Its XMP property pdfxid:GTS_PDFXVersion needs a PDF/A extension schema, which krilla does not write; PDF/A-1, -2 and -3 require one for every property outside the predefined schemas.

§

EmbeddedFile(EmbedError, Option<Location>)

The PDF contains an embedded file.

§

MissingTagging

The PDF contains no tagging.

§

EmbeddedPDF(Option<Location>)

The PDF contains another embedded PDF.

This is currently forbidden in validated export because we cannot manually verify whether the file actually fulfills all the criteria for the export mode.

§

RequiresNewerPdfVersion(VersionedFeature, Option<Location>)

A feature only available in a later PDF version was required.

§

OptionalContent(Option<Location>)

The PDF contains optional content groups, which PDF/A-1 forbids.

Occurs if Document::add_optional_content_group was called.
